task: Go to the bedroom, approach the light switch there, and turn the bedroom light on.
Go to the dining room, approach its light switch, and turn the dining-room light on.
Go to the home office, approach the television, and switch it off.
Go to the home office, approach the television, and switch it off.
Go to the home office, approach the computer, and switch it on.
Go to the home office, approach the computer, and switch it on.
Go to the bathroom, approach the toilet, and sit on it.
Go to the bathroom, approach the toilet, and sit on it.
Go to the home office, switch on the television, face it, and watch it while standing.
Go to the home office, switch on the television, then sit on the couch and watch it.
Retrieve the printing paper from the desk and load it into the fax machine's paper tray.
Retrieve the cheese from the freezer and eat it.
Go to the home-office window and look outside through it.
Find the child in the home office and greet them.
Go to the drawing in the home office and look at it.
Find the dog and pet it.
Enter the home office and pick up the phone from the desk.
Go to the bedroom and lie down on the bed to sleep.
Turn on the stereo in the home office and sit on the couch to listen.
Go to the home-office window and open it.
Go to the couch, sit down, and lie on it to relax.
Turn off the bedroom light using its light switch.
Retrieve the novel from the bedroom and read it.
Pick up the water glass from the dining table, drink from it, and return it to the table.
Go to the television in the home office and turn it on so it is ready to watch.
Go to the home office, sit on the chair at the desk, switch on the computer, and type an email with the keyboard.
Go to the home office, switch on the computer, open the mail application, and type an email with the keyboard.
Go to the bathroom sink, turn on the faucet, squeeze the soap, and wash both hands under running water.
At the bathroom sink, turn on the faucet, pick up the soap, scrub both hands, return the soap, and then wash both hands; this sequence ends with the faucet still on.
Go to the home office, approach the cat, face and look at it, and pet it.
Go to the home office, find and approach the cat, face and look at it, and pet it.
Go to the home office, sit in the desk chair, face the computer, and switch it on; remain seated with the computer on.
Go to the home office, pull out the desk chair, sit down, switch on the computer, and face it.
Go to the home office, switch on the television before sitting on the couch, then face it and watch TV.
Go to the home office, switch on the television before sitting on the couch, and then watch the program.
Move the plate near the dining table to the sink.
Use the rag to wipe the computer screen, then return the rag to its original place.
Retrieve a roll of toilet paper from the bathroom cabinet and leave the cabinet closed.
Place the popcorn bag inside the microwave, close it, and turn the microwave on.
Pick up the novel, sit on the couch, and read it.
Turn off both ceiling lights and the floor lamp in the dining room.
Use the remote control to turn on the television, then watch it.
Fill the drinking glass with water and drink from it.
Load the basket of clothes into the washing machine, close it, and start the machine.
Place the plate in the dishwasher, close it, and start the dishwasher.
Turn on the faucet and wash and rinse the plate by hand at the sink.
Use the rag to wipe the bathroom faucet and sink, then return the rag to its original place.
Use the duster to wipe the filing cabinet, then return the duster to its original place.
Retrieve the pants and shirt from the dresser and put both on.
Pick up the jacket and hang it on the wall hanger.
Go to the home office, take the newspaper from the desk chair, carry it to the couch, sit down, and read that same newspaper.
Go to the home office, sit in the desk chair, switch on the computer, and use the keyboard to browse the internet.
In the dining room, open and inspect the refrigerator. Then locate the separate kitchen cabinet, open it and check it for food. Close the cabinet, then close the refrigerator.
Stand up, go to the dining room, pick up the groceries, open the refrigerator, and place the groceries inside; this sequence ends with the refrigerator still open.
Go to the home office, sit on the chair at the computer, switch it on, type the email with the keyboard, and then switch the computer off while remaining seated.
Go to the home office, sit at the desk, switch on the computer, type on the keyboard, switch the computer off, and then stand up; do not leave the office.
Go to the home office, turn on the office light first, sit at the desk, switch on the computer, and type the email with the keyboard.
Go to the home office and sit at the desk, switch on the computer, pick up the mouse and point at the screen, return the mouse, and then type on the keyboard.
Go to the home office, sit in the desk chair, switch on the computer, use the keyboard to access Skype, then pick up the mouse and press the call control on the computer.
Open the refrigerator in the dining room, take the beer bottle, close the refrigerator, carry that same bottle to the home-office couch, sit down, and drink it.
Sit at the home-office computer, turn it on, open the email, type the message, then close the email and turn the computer off.
Sit at the home-office computer, turn it on, read the check, leave the check on the desk, and type on the keyboard.
Pick up an empty cup, take the milk from the freezer, pour some into the cup, and return the milk to the freezer. Leave the freezer closed.
Wash your hands with soap and running water, turn off the faucet, and dry your hands with a towel.
Place bread from the freezer in the toaster and switch it on, with the toaster plugged in and the freezer left closed.
Put the paper document from the filing cabinet into the powered-on shredder, and leave the filing cabinet closed.
Store the apple, egg, and fish from the dining table in the freezer, and leave the freezer closed when finished.
Retrieve the fork and plate from the kitchen cabinet and place both on the dining table.
Sit on the chair, pick up the remote control, point it at the television to turn the TV on, then return the remote.
Put the food on a plate, place the plate on the dining table, sit on the chair, and eat the meal.
Use a paper towel from the bathroom cabinet to wipe the mirror, dispose of the towel in the trashcan, and leave the cabinet closed.
Use the duster to wipe the chair, table, and dresser, then return the duster to its original place.
Use a toothbrush and toothpaste in the bathroom to brush your teeth, then rinse your mouth and the toothbrush at the running faucet, turn the faucet off, and put the toothbrush back.
Take three dresses from the bedroom dresser, lay each one on the bed, and leave the dresser closed when finished.
At the bathroom sink, turn on the faucet, wash your face with cleanser and a rinsed rag, turn the faucet off, dry your face with a towel, and return the towel.
